samples.title: Thói quen đi bộ
samples.prompt: The proposal is that communities should make everyday walking more convenient. Do the advantages of this proposal outweigh its disadvantages?
requirementsVi: Chọn bên có sức nặng hơn.
Thừa nhận và phân tích bất lợi.
So sánh mức độ tác động, không chỉ đếm số ý.
samples.summaryVi: Đi bộ dễ thành thói quen khi đường tới nơi cần đến thuận tiện và không bị cản trở.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The proposal that communities should make everyday walking more convenient has both positive and negative aspects. In my view, the advantages can outweigh the disadvantages if basic practical support is included. The main benefit addresses a recurring everyday need, while at least some of the difficulties can be reduced through careful organisation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu đánh giá và điều kiện rõ ràng.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận bất lợi
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that some routes are difficult to use. This matters because uneven paths, missing crossings and parked vehicles can create barriers. For instance, a parent with a pushchair may have to step into the road because the pavement is blocked. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không bỏ qua phía yếu hơn.

paragraphs.label: Lợi ích lớn hơn
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that people can include gentle movement in ordinary routines. This is possible because a useful route to a shop or bus stop can make walking part of a journey rather than an extra task. For example, a resident can walk to a nearby market instead of taking a motorbike for a very short trip. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đi bộ dễ thành thói quen khi đường tới nơi cần đến thuận tiện và không bị cản trở.

paragraphs.label: So sánh sức nặng
paragraphs.text: I give greater weight to the benefit because it could help people repeatedly, not just on one special occasion. The disadvantage is still important, but it is not always unavoidable. One response would be to keep pavements clear and improve practical walking routes. A local group could identify one important route to the market and report the barriers along it. This gives a concrete reason to believe that the obstacle can be reduced rather than merely ignored.
paragraphs.noteVi: So sánh tính lặp lại của lợi ích và khả năng giảm bất lợi.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I believe the advantages are greater when the approach is organised responsibly. If the practical support is absent, the balance could change. The strongest case is therefore for a workable version of the proposal, not for assuming that any version will automatically succeed.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt nhất quán, không khẳng định luôn đúng.

The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Theo dõi chi tiêu giúp thấy nhu cầu thiết yếu; kế hoạch phải có khoảng linh hoạt cho việc phát sinh.

paragraphs.label: So sánh sức nặng
paragraphs.text: I give greater weight to the benefit because it could help people repeatedly, not just on one special occasion. The disadvantage is still important, but it is not always unavoidable. One response would be to use a flexible plan and review it regularly. A learner could separate essential costs from optional purchases and leave a small amount for unexpected needs. This gives a concrete reason to believe that the obstacle can be reduced rather than merely ignored.
paragraphs.noteVi: So sánh tính lặp lại của lợi ích và khả năng giảm bất lợi.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I believe the advantages are greater when the approach is organised responsibly. If the practical support is absent, the balance could change. The strongest case is therefore for a workable version of the proposal, not for assuming that any version will automatically succeed.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt nhất quán, không khẳng định luôn đúng.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The proposal that people should protect some regular time for enjoyable hobbies has both positive and negative aspects. In my view, the advantages can outweigh the disadvantages if basic practical support is included. The main benefit addresses a recurring everyday need, while at least some of the difficulties can be reduced through careful organisation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu đánh giá và điều kiện rõ ràng.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận bất lợi
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that an ambitious hobby plan can become another source of pressure. This matters because expensive equipment and demanding goals may make a beginner feel unsuccessful. For instance, someone may stop practising music after trying to learn several difficult pieces in the first week. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Không bỏ qua phía yếu hơn.

paragraphs.label: Lợi ích lớn hơn
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that a hobby can provide a break from work and routine responsibilities. This is possible because an activity chosen for enjoyment gives people something to look forward to. For example, an office worker can spend one evening each week learning to draw with a small local group. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.

This gives a concrete reason to believe that the obstacle can be reduced rather than merely ignored.
